owned_review: Full independent canonical plus separate rendered C1-9/H1-15; both clean with zero substitutions, EOF reached.

notes.finding: The owned C defines one HSD_ObjAllocData and three scalars: signed animation count, unsigned effect count and unsigned load mode. Static storage begins zero by C semantics. Address and section comments do not establish compiled layout.
Public header declares the four owned globals plus foreign efAsync_AllocData; its definition is in efasync.c21. No functions or parameter identities exist in this TU.

Foreign allocator type asserts0x2C and contains allocation metadata; EF_Effect also occupies0x2C but is a separate type with different fields. Init sizes the allocator for EF_Effect and resets EffectCount, not the other two globals explicitly.

Load mode0 increments EffectCount before allocation; failure does not roll back. GObj failure cleanup tests the just-stored NULL gobj and reaches duplicate-free assertion. Destructor decrements only non-NULL-gobj mode0 effects. This is accounting, not a proven live population cap.

Animated creation increments signed AnimCount and writes the old-index queue slot before the>=32 guard. Dispatch epilogues predecrement and animate until count==0; negative counts/reentrant mutations lack a local guard.

Top-level spawn resets AnimCount and LoadKind to zero, early dispatch branches preserve zero and local recipes switch to mode1. Definitions name zero ASYNC and one SYNC despite the counterintuitive is_async member value.
